newsitem.title: USA: Ryder System Inc Q3 earnings summary.
newsitem.headline: Ryder System Inc Q3 earnings summary.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: First Call Q3 estimate $0.44 a share.
The 1995 results included a charge of $7.8 million, or $0.10 per share, due to a first quarter change in accounting for charitable contributions.

Earnings in the 1996 third quarter, excluding certain restructuring and other charges, were $34.2 million, or $0.42 per share in 1996, compared with $28.2 million, or $0.35 per share, in the same period of 1995.

Excluding certain restructuring and other charges, earnings in the first nine months of 1996 were $88.3 million, or $1.09 per share, compared with earnings in the first nine months last year of $106.3 million, or $1.34 per share.
Certain amounts for the 1995 periods have been reclassified to conform to 1996 classifications.
